deploy-preview.name: Deploy PR Preview
deploy-preview.if: always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action != 'closed' && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && needs.changes.outputs.aws_mutation_required == 'true' && needs.application-region.result == 'success' && needs.typecheck.result == 'success' && (needs.build-and-push-image.result == 'success' || needs.build-and-push-image.result == 'skipped') && (needs.build-human-acceptance-image.result == 'success' || needs.build-human-acceptance-image.result == 'skipped')

steps.name: Deployment maintenance gate
steps.run:
if [ "$PAUSED" = "true" ]; then
  echo "::error::AWS deployments are paused for guarded IAM maintenance"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Gate on AWS_PREVIEW_ROLE_ARN
steps.run:
if [ "$BOUNDARY_ENFORCED" != "true" ]; then
  echo "::notice::Guarded workload-boundary migration is incomplete — skipping preview deploy"
  echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
elif [ -z "$HAS_AWS" ]; then
  echo "::notice::AWS_PREVIEW_ROLE_ARN not configured — skipping preview deploy"
  echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Preflight — verify role is assumable
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! aws sts get-caller-identity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::OIDC role assumed but STS is unusable — check AWS_PREVIEW_ROLE_ARN / trust policy"
  exit 1
fi
if ! aws iam get-role --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::Role $ROLE_NAME not found — run scripts/deploy-github-role.sh to bootstrap it"
  exit 1
fi
if ! WORKLOAD_BOUNDARY_SKIP_DOTENV=true \
  scripts/deploy-workload-permissions-boundary.sh --verify-only; then
  echo "::error::Workload boundary preflight failed; see the diagnostic above"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Preflight OK: OIDC deploy role assumed"

steps.name: Remove conflicting Pulumi installation
steps.run:
# SST bundles its own Pulumi runtime; a globally-installed Pulumi can
# win the PATH lookup and produce a version mismatch. Persistent
# self-hosted runners can also cache stale provider binaries whose
# schemas lag the AWS SDK.
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/pulumi* 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf ~/.pulumi/plugins/ 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf ~/.config/sst/bin/ 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf ~/.config/sst/plugins/ 2>/dev/null || true

steps.name: Deploy PR stage
steps.run:
# PR_NUMBER comes from GitHub's pull_request payload (integer);
# validate to short-circuit any injection risk.
if ! [[ "$PR_NUMBER" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Invalid PR number: $PR_NUMBER"
  exit 1
fi
STAGE="pr-${PR_NUMBER}"
echo "stage=$STAGE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
echo "Deploying to stage: $STAGE"

# Detect namespace-aware metadata without launching its cached task.
# The new owner bootstrap runs only after this deployment and drain.
PARAMETER_ERROR=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$PARAMETER_ERROR"' EXIT
set +e
EXISTING_TASK_DEF=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
  --name "/mem9-on-aws/${STAGE}/bootstrap/task-def-arn" \
  --region "$AWS_REGION" \
  --query Parameter.Value \
  --output text 2>"$PARAMETER_ERROR")
PARAMETER_STATUS=$?
set -e
if [ "$PARAMETER_STATUS" -eq 0 ]; then
  BOOTSTRAP_VERSION=$(aws ecs describe-task-definition \
    --task-definition "$EXISTING_TASK_DEF" \
    --region "$AWS_REGION" \
    --query "taskDefinition.containerDefinitions[0].environment[?name=='MEM9_NAMESPACE_BOOTSTRAP_VERSION'].value | [0]" \
    --output text)
  if [ "$BOOTSTRAP_VERSION" = "1" ]; then
    echo "Namespace-aware preview detected"
    export MEM9_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED="1"
  else
    echo "Legacy preview detected; deploying namespace compatibility first"
    export MEM9_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED="0"
  fi
elif grep -q "ParameterNotFound" "$PARAMETER_ERROR"; then
  export MEM9_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED="0"
else
  echo "::error::Could not determine whether preview stage exists: $(head -c 400 "$PARAMETER_ERROR")"
  exit "$PARAMETER_STATUS"
fi
echo "initial_namespace_required=$MEM9_NAMESPACE_REQUIRED" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

# Clear any stale SST state lock left by a cancelled previous run.
pnpm -C infra exec sst unlock --stage "$STAGE" 2>&1 || true

set +e
pnpm -C infra exec sst deploy --stage "$STAGE" --print-logs 2>&1 | tee sst-deploy.log
EXIT=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
set -e
if [ "$EXIT" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "::error::SST deployment failed (exit $EXIT)"
  exit "$EXIT"
fi

steps.name: Drain preview service and previous bootstrap tasks

deploy-prod.name: Deploy prod
deploy-prod.if:
always() && !inputs.runtime_cutover && (github.event_name == 'push' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && needs.changes.outputs.aws_mutation_required == 'true' && needs.application-region.result == 'success' && needs.typecheck.result == 'success' && needs.verify-production-image-transition.result == 'success' && (
  (needs.verify-production-image-transition.outputs.image_transition == 'true' && needs.build-image-transition-control.result == 'success' && needs.build-and-push-image.result == 'skipped')
  || (needs.verify-production-image-transition.outputs.image_transition == 'false' && needs.build-image-transition-control.result == 'skipped' && (needs.build-and-push-image.result == 'success' || needs.build-and-push-image.result == 'skipped'))
)

steps.name: Deployment maintenance gate
steps.run:
if [ "$PAUSED" = "true" ]; then
  echo "::error::AWS deployments are paused for guarded IAM maintenance"
  exit 1
fi
if [ "$BOUNDARY_ENFORCED" != "true" ]; then
  echo "::error::Guarded workload-boundary migration is incomplete — refusing prod deployment"
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Gate on AWS_PROD_ROLE_ARN (hard-fail)
steps.run:
if [ -z "$HAS_AWS" ]; then
  echo "::error::AWS_PROD_ROLE_ARN not configured — cannot deploy prod."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Preflight — verify role is assumable
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if ! aws sts get-caller-identity >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::OIDC role assumed but STS is unusable — check AWS_PROD_ROLE_ARN / trust policy"
  exit 1
fi
if ! aws iam get-role --role-name "$ROLE_NAME" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "::error::Role $ROLE_NAME not found — run scripts/deploy-github-role.sh to bootstrap it"
  exit 1
fi
if ! WORKLOAD_BOUNDARY_SKIP_DOTENV=true \
  scripts/deploy-workload-permissions-boundary.sh --verify-only; then
  echo "::error::Workload boundary preflight failed; see the diagnostic above"
  exit 1
fi
echo "Preflight OK: OIDC deploy role assumed"

steps.name: Resolve deployed image tag
steps.run:
image_tag="$BUILT_IMAGE_TAG"
if [[ "$IMAGE_TRANSITION" == 'true' ]]; then
  if ! [[ "$CONTROL_IMAGE_TAG" =~ ^mem9-[0-9a-f]{7}$ ]] || ! [[ "$CONTROL_IMAGE_DIGEST" =~ ^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]; then
    echo "::error::Verified control build output is missing"
    exit 1
  fi
  image_tag="$CONTROL_IMAGE_TAG"
elif [[ "$IMAGE_TRANSITION" != 'false' ]]; then
  echo "::error::Verified image transition selection is missing"
  exit 1
fi
if [[ -z "$image_tag" ]]; then
  image_tag=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
    --name /mem9-on-aws/prod/ecs/image-tag \
    --region "$AWS_REGION" \
    --query Parameter.Value \
    --output text)
fi
if ! [[ "$image_tag" =~ ^mem9-[0-9a-f]{7}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Production image tag is unavailable or malformed"
  exit 1
fi
echo "image_tag=$image_tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Remove conflicting Pulumi installation
steps.run:
sudo rm -f /usr/local/bin/pulumi* 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf ~/.pulumi/plugins/ 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf ~/.config/sst/bin/ ~/.config/sst/plugins/ 2>/dev/null || true

steps.name: Recover stale SST prod lock
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
BOOTSTRAP_JSON=$(aws ssm get-parameter \
  --name /sst/bootstrap \
  --query Parameter.Value \
  --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
if [[ -z "$BOOTSTRAP_JSON" ]]; then
  echo "::notice::No /sst/bootstrap in ${AWS_REGION} — first prod deploy, no lock to recover"
  exit 0
fi
STATE_BUCKET=$(echo "$BOOTSTRAP_JSON" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('state',''))")
if [[ -z "$STATE_BUCKET" ]]; then
  echo "::error::Could not parse 'state' from /sst/bootstrap"
  exit 1
fi
# SST's lock key layout has varied across versions; probe the common
# variants and unlock via the CLI (which knows the real key) if any
# is present + stale.
LAST_MODIFIED=""
for LOCK_KEY in "app/mem9-on-aws/.lock/prod.json" "lock/mem9-on-aws/prod.json"; do
  LAST_MODIFIED=$(aws s3api head-object --bucket "$STATE_BUCKET" --key "$LOCK_KEY" \
    --query LastModified --output text 2>/dev/null || true)
  [[ -n "$LAST_MODIFIED" ]] && break
done
if [[ -z "$LAST_MODIFIED" ]]; then
  echo "No lock object — proceeding with deploy"
  exit 0
fi
# One-liner python3 -c (no heredoc): a `<<'PY'` heredoc inside a YAML
# `run: |` block keeps the closing PY indented, so bash never sees the
# column-0 terminator and the step dies with "unexpected EOF" the first
# time a lock exists. Semicolon form has no indentation-significant body.
AGE_MINUTES=$(python3 -c 'import sys; from datetime import datetime, timezone; last = datetime.fromisoformat(sys.argv[1].replace("Z", "+00:00")); print(f"{(datetime.now(timezone.utc) - last).total_seconds() / 60:.1f}")' "$LAST_MODIFIED")
echo "Lock LastModified: $LAST_MODIFIED (age ${AGE_MINUTES} min)"
if ! [[ "$AGE_MINUTES" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::Could not parse lock age: '${AGE_MINUTES}'"; exit 1
fi
if awk "BEGIN { exit !(${AGE_MINUTES} > ${STALE_LOCK_AGE_MINUTES}) }"; then
  echo "::warning::Stale prod lock (age ${AGE_MINUTES} min > ${STALE_LOCK_AGE_MINUTES}). Auto-unlocking."
  pnpm -C infra exec sst unlock --stage prod
else
  echo "::error::prod lock is fresh (age ${AGE_MINUTES} min <= ${STALE_LOCK_AGE_MINUTES}). Refusing to unlock — a concurrent deploy may be running."
  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Seed OAuth HMAC key (workflow_dispatch only)
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
KEY=$(openssl rand -base64 32)
pnpm -C infra exec sst secret set OauthStateHmacKey "$KEY" --stage prod
echo "::notice::OauthStateHmacKey seeded for prod (re-linked by the deploy below)"

Refresh image upgrade authorization before SST

build-and-push-image.name: Build & push workload images
build-and-push-image.if:
always() && !inputs.runtime_cutover && needs.changes.outputs.workload_changed == 'true' && needs.application-region.result == 'success' && needs.typecheck.result == 'success' && (github.event_name == 'pull_request' || (needs.verify-production-image-transition.result == 'success' && needs.verify-production-image-transition.outputs.image_transition == 'false')) && (

steps.name: Deployment maintenance gate
steps.run:
if [ "$PAUSED" = "true" ]; then

  exit 1
fi

steps.name: Gate on scope-specific AWS role
steps.run:
if [ "$BOUNDARY_ENFORCED" != "true" ]; then
  if [ "$EVENT_NAME" != "pull_request" ]; then
    echo "::error::Guarded workload-boundary migration is incomplete — refusing AWS image publication"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::notice::Guarded workload-boundary migration is incomplete — skipping preview image builds"
  echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
elif [ -z "$HAS_AWS" ]; then
  if [ "$EVENT_NAME" != "pull_request" ]; then
    echo "::error::AWS_PROD_ROLE_ARN not configured — cannot build/push workload images for prod."
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::notice::AWS_PREVIEW_ROLE_ARN not configured — skipping preview image builds"
  echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
else
  echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
fi

steps.name: Resolve per-image tag lists
steps.run:
emit() { # $1 = image name (repo leaf), $2 = output key
  {
    echo "$2<<EOF"
    while IFS= read -r tag; do
      [ -n "$tag" ] && echo "${REGISTRY}/${ECR_NS}/$1:${tag}"
    done <<< "$IMAGE_TAGS"
    echo "EOF"
  } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
}
